mechanism: Valganciclovir can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities; combined with torsemide's diuretic effect and renal effects, this increases risk of acute kidney injury, severe hypokalemia, and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and fluid status closely; adjust diuretic dosing based on renal function; consider potassium and magnesium supplementation.
